about.bio:
Coach Arkansas Chadwick Lewis brings 19 years of experience running the Wing-T system in Arkansas. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Chadwick Lewis is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the College, Varsity, JV/Frosh, Middle School, Youth level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Chadwick Lewis delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.
